# Body Contouring Academy

> > Clinician-led online certification and masterclass training in body contouring technologies and aesthetic business practices for med-spa professionals.

Body Contouring Academy is founded by Shannon and Kay, medspa owners since 2006, offering comprehensive certification programs in non-invasive body contouring treatments including cryolipolysis, ultrasonic cavitation, radiofrequency, pressotherapy, and EMS. The academy combines technical training with business growth education to help practitioners launch and scale their aesthetic practices.

## Key Topics

- Body Contouring Certification
- Cryolipolysis
- Pressotherapy
- Vacuum Therapy
- 6-in-1 Masterclass
- Ultrasonic Cavitation
- Radiofrequency (RF)
- EMS Training
- Med-Spa Business Growth
- Non-Invasive Treatments
- Online Certification Courses
- Practice Development
- Aesthetic Business Training
- Professional Development

## Certification Programs

- [Body Contouring 6-in-1 Masterclass Certification Course](https://bodycontouringacademy.com/body-contouring-6-in-1-masterclass): 6-in-1 Masterclass covering ultrasonic cavitation, RF, lipo-laser, and LED technologies
- [Core Body Contouring Certification Courses](https://bodycontouringacademy.com/core-body-contouring-certification-courses): Core certifications in cryolipolysis and advanced vacuum therapy
- [Body Contouring Certification Course Pathways](https://bodycontouringacademy.com/body-contouring-certification-course-pathways): Course pathway guide for selecting body contouring certification options
- [Online Courses, Body Contouring Certification, Fast & Easy](https://bodycontouringacademy.com/online-courses): Main courses page with Beginner, Business, and Expert bundles

## Advanced Training & Specializations

- [Advanced & Add-On Trainings](https://bodycontouringacademy.com/advanced-add-on-trainings): Advanced trainings in EMS, pressotherapy, and vibration therapy
